svg.title: Digitakt II track keyboard, arpeggiator and CANOPY SRC
svg.desc: Eight proposed 128 by 64 screens. The audio track has an SMP badge and level fader. Holding TRIG PARAMETERS changes the captions to values. The MIDI track leaves its level column empty. The NOTES list shows ordered intervals and velocities. The lower screens show the shared keyboard and the wavetable version of all three CANOPY source pages.
